capabilities.summary: Spend reservation, allowance and compare-and-swap ledger on SQLite: integer micro-units, idempotent reserve on request id, in-flight and overrun handling, opaque allowance periods, optional account key and per-reservation currency, billed-unknown commit, caller-transaction (`_in`/`_on`) variants, strict transition mode, carry-over, atomic multi-cap reserve with epoch-reset device allowance, caller and process budgets, provider-reported cost and invoice reconciliation, cap-setting audit, optional overrun gate
policyNotes: Declaration-only: the ledger tables and reservation state machine are not an ownership fingerprint.
Price rows live in rightkit-llm; the ledger stores opaque route and price-version text; an allowance holds no currency and a reservation holds only the currency text the caller passes.
